about_the_game:
『Duola Mage』 is a retro action game that abandons the 'high-speed' combat style where characters are hard to see amidst the chaos, allowing every move and attack to be clear and solid.

We have included a large variety of weapons such as greatswords, katanas, bows, staves, and gauntlets, with each weapon having its own unique skill—yes, every single one. All weapons can be upgraded, and we’ve also paid homage to classic monster weapons.

Players can have multiple characters at the same time in the game and switch between them freely during combat. Each character has a unique appearance and combat style, such as a heavy and brutal female warrior, a nimble and agile elven archer, a graceful swordsman, and a flashy yet violent time-space mage. We’ve made a strong effort to make each character's combat distinct; switching characters doesn't just mean changing special effects.

Currently, we have developed 11 main story levels, with the later dungeons being more like intricately designed miniature worlds. Each map features hidden bosses and treasure chests and buffs that require climbing to reach, greatly enhancing players’ exploration desire. The natural environments of the dungeons are also varied, ranging from the deep and mysterious tree spirit forest, to the grand and weighty primeval desert, to lava pits that feel like hellfire, and eerie spider nests shrouded in mist.

In addition to the main story levels, another core gameplay mode is the Trials, which is also known to fans as roguelike gameplay. In the Trials, monsters get stronger with each floor, and after defeating a round of monsters, players receive one of three selectable buffs. We’ve set up a Trials leaderboard, where players who reach the highest floor can earn a special title.

● Level Introduction

There are currently 10 main levels, 1 roguelike ladder, and 6 solo boss levels. Levels have three difficulties: Easy, Hard, and Hell. Ratings are S/A/B/C/D, and rewards are divided into fixed level rewards and rating rewards. The higher the rating, the more materials you get. Rating factors include: time, buff acquisition, and temporary missions.

● Trial Ladder Roguelike Gameplay

Classic buff selection of 3 options, switch scenes every 3 levels with a random boss, materials can be chosen freely. Scenes change randomly, so you won’t get bored defending one spot.

● Mounts

Adorable and cute mounts accompany you on your adventures..

     

      

● Super exciting battles with clearly defined classes

Izumi Nao

Samurai—requires precise skill: drawing the sword in one motion, instant dash slashes, timing attacks carefully, and using a cold blade to strike the throat.

Bella

Mage — a mobile turret, a bit fragile, but with Black Hole and Meteor, a godly clearing skill, perfect for mowing down enemies.

Andrew

Druid — transform into a werewolf, summon a storm eagle, and embody the explosive power of nature and beastliness.

Lucian

Elf Archer — Explosive Dragon Arrow, Dragon Capturing Kick, Agile Movements, Unerring Aim.

Deca

Phoenix — Summon fire dragons and the song of the phoenix, incorporating the art of flames into combat to scorch enemies.

Disi

Descendant of the Valkyrie — The Wrath of the War God confronts the dragon head-on.

● Weapon Special Skill

Each weapon has unique special skills, which you can match with characters as you like. There are over a hundred weapons to choose from, but only five are shown below.

[Zantari Crystal Sword] 'Demon Swordsman'

Weapon Skill: [Adrian's Moonlight]

[Holy Light's Sanctuary Bow] 'Nuns Can Shoot Too'

Weapon Skill: [Faith Rune] Passive Skill: [Faith Holy Light Arrow]

【Blood Sacrifice Greatsword】"Blood Extractor"

Weapon Skill: 【Blood Altar】 Passive Skill: 【Blood Mark】

【Skull Frost Staff】"A Song of Ice and Fire"

Weapon Skill: 【Summon Ice Dragon】 Passive Skill: 【Frost Orb】

【Andreophis Warblade】"Resembling a Demon Hunter"

Weapon Skill: 【Demon Eye Prism】 Passive Skill: 【Demon's Grip】

● Character Development - Equipment Forging

All equipment depends on crafting, so you don't have to worry about low drop rates.

● 200 outfits, making it hard to decide what to wear when going out...

Outfits are divided by male and female characters, weapon skins, equipment skins, and back accessories.

● Back accessories not only enhance appearance but also provide skill boosts.

[Ogre's Head]

Skill: Ogre's Roar

[Sword Control Technique]

Skill: Sword Control

[Snow Fox Nine-Tails]

Skill: Snow Fox Agility

● Multiplayer, coming soon

Invite your friends to explore and fight monsters together.

Thank you for watching.

short_description: Elegant art style, passionate battles! 'Duola Mage' is a 'kawaii' adventure action game where you can choose multiple characters, each with unique class skills. Enjoy the satisfying roguelike ladder and the main quest’s combination of 'search, fight, and collect' tasks.
